About

AI can never replace good taste.

Eight years of motion design, five of them at Business Insider. I earned my Bachelor's in Design from Loyola University New Orleans, where a passion for animated music videos and visualizers pulled me toward motion. Most of my inspiration comes from vaporwave, Memphis design, and Islamic art.

I've worked across media companies, hospitals, banks, unions, musicians, and local businesses. My style ranges from Memphis-inflected flat design to mixed-media photocollage to vaporwave and neo-psychedelia, built mainly in After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere, and Procreate.

I'm extending that toolkit into 3D with Blender and Cinema 4D, and folding AI into the workflow as a tool, not an author — Claude for design and build, Gemini and GPT Image for photo editing and cleanup. The tools are fast; the direction, taste, and final call stay with me. I've designed, vibe-coded, and shipped full websites for clients this way.
